newsitem.title: USA: CMS Energy unit in natural gas pact.
newsitem.headline: CMS Energy unit in natural gas pact.

text.p: Consumers Energy, the principal subsidiary of CMS Energy Corp, said Wednesday it reached a 20-year natural gas transportation agreement with its largest gas transportation customer, General Motors Corp.
It said the agreement represents an estimated 23.3 billion cubic feet of natural gas annually.

Under the agreement, Consumers Energy will deliver natural gas through the year 2016 to 25 GM facilities it serves throughout Michigan's Lower Peninsula. GM represents about 25 percent of Consumer Energy's total gas transportation volume, excluding gas transportation to the Midland Cogeneration Venture and off-system deliveries.
